WS9 uses temperature_stripped inside decoding, never 'stripped'.

'calibration' is overloaded — WS6's judge-vs-human artifacts vs WS9's simulator calibration in the same summary.yaml: rename WS6's run-level detail block from summary['calibration'] to summary['human_calibration'] (the per-judge key human_agreement and the `score.py calibration` subcommand stay); WS9's stays nested at simulator.calibration. Glossary entry (PR11) disambiguates the full family: stability (raw within-run agreement) / stability.irr (single-judge self-consistency alpha, upper bound on IRR) / panel (cross-model inter-judge alpha) / human_agreement (criterion validity vs one reviewer) / simulator.calibration (V2 shadow-vs-human) / anova.json reliability (cross-replication pipeline test-retest ICC).

Near-collision to document, not rename — thresholds.simulator (WS9 reserved key) vs thresholds.simulator_provenance (WS3's builtin-judge recipe): distinct keys, one docs sentence placed next to each so users don't conflate them; WS9's load-time rejection of a judge literally named 'simulator' lands in PR9.

Judge/label hygiene invariants shared by all PRs (grep-enforced in WS1/WS2/WS7 tests, adopted repo-wide): no Landis-Koch adjectives anywhere; 'single-judge self-consistency alpha (upper bound on inter-rater reliability)' verbatim label; paper citations use Sec 5.3/10.2/10.4/11.3/A.1/B.4/B.5, never 'Sec 6.4'; every uncorrected percent-agreement number carries the word 'uncorrected'.

## Cumulative NEW eval.yaml surface (WS1–WS9). Everything is opt-in: omitting all
## keys below leaves existing configs behaviorally byte-identical.
## WS1 (IRR math), WS4 (dataset audit — CLI flags only), WS5 (null probe),
## WS7 (validity report / MLflow routing) add NO eval.yaml keys.

judges:
  - name: task_quality
    llm_rubric: "Rate the response quality..."
    score_range: [1, 5]
    samples: 3                  # existing key; >=2 unlocks stability.irr (WS2/PR2)
    consequence: safety         # WS2 · opt-in · exploratory|safety|gating ->
                                #   tier-default min_alpha 0.67/0.70/0.80 resolved at
                                #   detection time (config.thresholds never mutated);
                                #   0.70/0.80 author-proposed, only 0.67 literature-backed;
                                #   load warning when samples: 1
    model:                      # WS8 · opt-in · string stays valid (default, unchanged);
      - claude-sonnet-4-5       #   a LIST declares a judge panel: k samples PER model,
      - gpt-4o                  #   majority/median reduction, cases x models Krippendorff
      - gemini-2.5-pro          #   alpha + family label. Non-Anthropic ids are gateway
                                #   aliases via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (single Anthropic-
                                #   Messages client; make_judge fallback rejects panels)

  - name: simulator_provenance  # WS3 · opt-in · builtin judge, zero new config keys
    builtin: process/simulator_provenance

thresholds:
  task_quality:
    min_alpha: 0.75             # WS2 · self-consistency alpha gate (upper bound on IRR).
                                #   reason_code perfect_agreement PASSES; samples:1 /
                                #   all-errored / insufficient data FAILS. Local scoring
                                #   path only — skipped with a notice on harbor/evalhub
    min_human_agreement: 0.60   # WS6 · judge-vs-human kappa/alpha, post-hoc: absent
                                #   human_agreement key (not yet calibrated) NEVER regresses
    min_panel_alpha: 0.67       # WS8 · cross-model panel alpha (requires model: list);
                                #   same degenerate carve-out + harbor/evalhub skip
  pairwise_judge_name:
    min_alpha: 0.7              # WS2 · gates pairwise verdict-stability alpha
                                #   (requires pairwise --samples > 1)
  simulator_provenance:
    min_pass_rate: 1.0          # WS3 · existing key — no case may run on fallback/
                                #   disabled/unrecorded simulated-user answers
  simulator:                    # WS9 · RESERVED key (judge named 'simulator' rejected
    max_fallback_rate: 0.0      #   at load). Configured-but-unavailable = regression on
    min_gold_agreement: 0.80    #   the local path; stripped with a notice on harbor AND
                                #   evalhub. min_gold_agreement gates the HUMAN-provenance
                                #   override stratum only (agent pairs never satisfy it)
    min_cross_simulator_agreement: 0.70   # WS9-PR2 · requires models.hook_shadow
    # min_self_consistency: REJECTED today — reserved for the samples:k follow-up

inputs:
  tools:
    - match: "Questions asked to the user via AskUserQuestion."
      prompt: "Answer from input.yaml guidance."
      calibration: true         # WS9 · opt-in (default false) · shadow-runs the LLM tier
                                #   on override-answered questions, HELD-OUT (answers.yaml
                                #   stripped); logged to hook_answers.jsonl, never injected

                                #   vacuous; ledger records decoding config now

models:

    - gemini-2.5-flash          #   answers logged for cross_simulator agreement, never
